expectedEffect: Preserve all 12 completed wafer lots, 88 delivered DRAM devices, contract value, service, and quality while reducing average known-good-die exposure at packaging-1.die-input by approximately four units.
hypothesis: A five-card CONWIP loop reopening at four lots will preserve the fixed twelve-lot memory-fab workload while reducing concurrent die batches waiting at packaging, without hiding inventory in smaller Buffers or changing physical transport capacity.
name: Five-card back-end WIP cadence
